name: context-relay
description: Create evidence-backed, privacy-aware handoff packs for long-running AI coding work.

interface.shortDescription: Verified project handoffs for fresh AI tasks
interface.longDescription: Turn the context visible to an AI coding task plus authorized workspace evidence into a versioned, privacy-aware handoff pack. Context Relay separates verified work from plans and unknowns, checks freshness, and creates a clean bootstrap prompt for the next task.
defaultPrompt: Create a verified handoff pack for this project.
Resume this project from its latest handoff and verify what changed.
Audit this handoff for stale claims, missing evidence, and secrets.
